ops.title: Preserve failed query filters when including tool errors
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_related_topk_ship. New remote with_errors property in Capt488 correctly serves default touches, but failed().with_errors widens its only-error filter unlike existing local SDK. Isolated one-line correction and real chain assertions source-PASS74b9ef78 in FE/capt-ticket-touch-query-parity-peer-review.json. ROOT agrees ship ready488 independently, carry correction in next native-ticket consumer after rebasing onto488, real native/local chains and normal carrier CI, release/install/verify. Reconcile488 uses() through generation-owned sessions instead of legacy self.sessions(), otherwise Python raw root_excerpt reads return; existing16MiB cold/warm/revocation fixture must catch this.

ops.text: Independent review and real native/local chain tests prove failed().with_errors stays filtered while default includes failed and pending calls.
Native consumer reconciliation uses generation-owned sessions for touches; whole-output/root16MiB source-byte and freshness fixtures pass.
Carrier merged, publicly released, guarded local install and affected query operation verified; no task closure on source-only proof.
